name: StoryCrest
original_description:
Turn your child into the hero of their own printed picture book.

Tell ChatGPT your child's first name, what they love and any occasion. Build their character right in the chat (skin colour, hair, glasses, freckles), pick an art style, and StoryCrest draws the real cover and writes the story outline so you can see exactly what you are getting. Ask for changes in plain words and get a new cover.

When you are happy, order the finished book as an 8.5" × 8.5" hardcover on storycrestbooks.com. After you order, every page is illustrated with your character in the style you chose, then the book is printed and shipped to you, in most countries worldwide.

StoryCrest is for parents, guardians and gift-givers. No photos or birthdays are needed: just a first name and a few drawing choices.
